correction_scope: Point-in-time metadata only; formulas, thresholds, provider set, quality outcomes, approval gates, and decision are unchanged.
original_behavior: Derived available_at stored the latest included provider input time.
corrected_behavior: Derived available_at stores the fixed composite decision time: observation_time plus one hour and five minutes.
provider_availability_provenance: Each provider input remains linked by its immutable raw observation ID; only inputs available by the fixed decision time are included.
governance_note: The original frozen artifact is retained rather than rewritten. This correction closes an availability-field naming bug and does not constitute post-validation model retuning.
